comments.author: TheSunGod
comments.body_html:
Hello good people, once again me, but this time with a completely different issue. I know you provide no official support, but i will still report it (i’m trying to get to the bottom of why it’s happening and hopefully get it fixed, since i love the mod otherwise and would like to continue using it without the “duct tape” workaround fix i came up with).

I found a reproducible issue with CNN Containers affecting specific rigs, notably the MPPV (5df8a42886f77412640e2e75) - maybe some others are affected too, but i didn’t check every single one in game or in the files, and it’s the only one causing the issue that i’ve encountered so far.

Environment:

  • Clean, just downloaded SPT-AKI 4.0.13 install, made from also freshly downloaded latest EFT
  • Only mod installed: CNN Containers, Version 4.2.2

Issue: The MPPV rig cannot accept any items. Every attempt results in “Item is not compatible” popup.

Details:

  • In the base SPT database (SPT_data/database/templates/items.json), this rig has empty “filters” for its grids
  • In vanilla behavior, because of the absence of filters the game correctly falls back to default container compatibility logic, so the rig works as expected

With CNN Containers enabled:

  • This fallback behavior appears to be overridden or not handled
  • As a result, grids with empty filters reject all items

Workaround: Manually adding a universal generic loot filter [“54009119af1c881c07000029”] to every grid for the MPPV rig in SPT_data/database/templates/items.json fixes the issue:

This suggests that the mod assumes all grids for all rigs have explicit filters and does not handle the fallback in case of their absence.

Impact:

  • Only affects rigs relying on fallback logic that don’t have explicit filters listed in items.json (e.g. MPPV, maybe others)
  • Other rigs with defined filters work correctly

Expected behavior:

  • If a grid has no filters, default compatibility logic should still apply (as in vanilla SPT)

I will continue to play the game with my “duct-tape” workaround fix for now (since MPPV is my favourite rig in the game lol), and in case i stumble upon any other rig that has the same issue, I will definitely update this or post a new comment!
